purpose: Current-source ETTh1 validation of an AutoCon-representation-gated linear blend aimed at the documented low-dimensional failure boundary.
research_question: Can the existing MambaTSv3 AutoCon representation-gated blend recover ETTh1 performance without sacrificing the Mamba/AutoCon contract?
evidence_boundary: Validation-only. No test metrics or predictions are generated. A pass does not authorize a held-out release.
claim_boundary: This is a single-domain mechanism screen; it cannot establish universal accuracy, causal AutoCon attribution, or general efficiency.

required_before_launch: verify ETTh1 fingerprint and exact 12-job expansion
freeze blend bias and all baseline contracts
keep test execution disabled for every job
preserve one source snapshot and output root

selection_contract.freeze_rule: Blend mode, bias=-4, AutoCon lambda, all baseline models, optimizer and epoch budget are fixed before launch; no post-hoc retuning is allowed.

capacity_fairness_contract.common_public_budget: All arms share split, features, sequence length, horizon, optimizer, scheduler, batch, epoch budget, patience and normalization.
capacity_fairness_contract.candidate_boundary: Only the blend arm enables mamba_ts_repr_linear_expert=true; it reuses the v3 persistence forecast and the AutoCon representation without a second Mamba scan.
capacity_fairness_contract.efficiency_boundary: Any latency conclusion requires a separate fixed-shape prediction-only resource measurement.

phases.name: blend_h96_validation
phases.purpose: AutoCon-representation-gated bounded Mamba/persistence blend on ETTh1.

phases.name: control_h96_validation
phases.purpose: Exact current-source MambaTSv3 AutoCon control without the linear blend.

phases.name: baselines_h96_validation
phases.purpose: Current-source ETTh1 linear and patch reference baselines.

comparison_contract.primary_contrast: blend candidate minus exact current-source MambaTSv3AutoCon control
comparison_contract.pass_rule: Blend must improve exact control in at least 2/3 seeds and have mean validation MSE no worse than 2% above the strongest external baseline.

stopping_rules: If either paired-control or strongest-baseline gate fails, stop this ETTh1 blend route without held-out release or bias retuning.
Do not call the blend an AutoCon causal effect; the representation and blend are jointly changed.
Report all arms and all seeds, including failures.

freeze blend bias and all baseline contracts
keep test execution disabled for every job
preserve one source snapshot and output root
